recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source already carries the semantic clarification; any purely editorial cleanup of nearby grammar should be handled as a separate technical correction rather than as part of this seed reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking FHIR-core-search to clarify that a quantity search value with a system searches the coded Quantity.system/Quantity.code form, while omitting the system allows matching the supplied text against either Quantity.code or Quantity.unit.
initial_application: The request was applied by fe49f5736558e8ba99509de97187a447a9c0fbb9 (svn revision 13374, 'GF#13646 - clarifications about searching quantity'), which updated source/search.html with the system/code explanation and code-vs-unit example detail.
additional_context: The linked implementers Zulip thread confirms the original interpretation and tracker creation. Later Published issue FHIR-19597 clarified the systemless side of the same rule and is already represented on the combined branch; adjacent FHIR-13874 canonical-unit clarification does not change this system/code versus human-unit-display behavior. Confluence and quoted issue-key community searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/search.html states that [parameter]={[prefix]}[number]|[system]|[code] matches by value, system, and code, while [parameter]={[prefix]}[number]||[code] matches by value and code or unit, and the examples/prose preserve the requested implementer rule.

related_jiras.note: Later Published clarification of systemless Quantity.code-or-Quantity.unit search behavior in the same source section; already represented on the combined branch by d47a6e2c369886147586982c8fbe0da156c16a09.
Adjacent Published clarification about canonical unit conversion on the quantity search page; it does not modify the FHIR-13646 system/code matching rule.
